class.name: StyleBoxCSS
class.brief_description: A [StyleBox] that reproduces the CSS box model.
class.description: [StyleBoxCSS] paints the CSS box of an HTML element: [code]background[/code], [code]border[/code] (per-side width, color and style), [code]border-radius[/code] (with elliptical corners), [code]padding[/code], [code]box-sizing[/code] and [code]box-shadow[/code]. It is used by [WebSVG] as its [theme_item WebSVG.style] theme item, but can decorate any control that draws a [StyleBox]. All defaults match the browser user-agent stylesheet for an [code]<svg>[/code] element: a transparent background, no border, no shadow, zero padding and content-box sizing.

method.name: get_border_color
method.description: Returns the border color of the given side.

method.name: get_border_style
method.description: Returns the border style of the given side.

method.name: get_border_width
method.description: Returns the border width of the given side, in pixels.

method.name: get_content_box
method.description: Returns the content box for the given border box: inset by the effective border widths and then by the padding.

method.name: get_corner_radius
method.description: Returns the radius of the given corner. [member Vector2.x] is the horizontal radius and [member Vector2.y] the vertical radius.

method.name: get_padding
method.description: Returns the padding of the given side, in pixels.

method.name: get_padding_box
method.description: Returns the padding box for the given border box: inset by the effective border widths.

method.name: set_border_color_all
method.description: Sets the border color of all four sides at once.

method.name: set_border_color
method.description: Sets the border color of the given side.

method.name: set_border_style_all
method.description: Sets the border style of all four sides at once.

method.name: set_border_style
method.description: Sets the border style of the given side.

method.name: set_border_width_all
method.description: Sets the border width of all four sides at once, in pixels.

method.name: set_border_width
method.description: Sets the border width of the given side, in pixels.

method.name: set_corner_radius_all
method.description: Sets the radius of all four corners at once.

method.name: set_corner_radius
method.description: Sets the radius of the given corner. [member Vector2.x] is the horizontal radius and [member Vector2.y] the vertical radius.

method.name: set_padding_all
method.description: Sets the padding of all four sides at once, in pixels.

method.name: set_padding
method.description: Sets the padding of the given side, in pixels.

members.member: The area the background is painted into: the border box, padding box or content box. CSS [code]background-clip[/code]. Defaults to border box.
Fill color of the box background. CSS [code]background-color[/code]. Defaults to transparent.

Optional linear gradient painted over [member background_color], clipped like the background. CSS [code]background-image: linear-gradient(...)[/code] (or [code]repeating-linear-gradient[/code] with [member background_gradient_repeating]).
Gradient direction in CSS degrees: [code]0[/code] points up ([code]to top[/code]), [code]90[/code] points right, [code]180[/code] (the CSS default [code]to bottom[/code]) points down.
If [code]true[/code], the gradient tiles every [member background_gradient_period] pixels along its axis, like CSS [code]repeating-linear-gradient()[/code].
Tile length in pixels for a repeating gradient. [code]0[/code] uses the full gradient line (no visible repetition).
Color of the bottom border edge. CSS [code]border-bottom-color[/code].
Color of the left border edge. CSS [code]border-left-color[/code].
Color of the right border edge. CSS [code]border-right-color[/code].
Color of the top border edge. CSS [code]border-top-color[/code].
Line style of the bottom border edge. CSS [code]border-bottom-style[/code]. Defaults to none.
Line style of the left border edge. CSS [code]border-left-style[/code]. Defaults to none.
Line style of the right border edge. CSS [code]border-right-style[/code]. Defaults to none.
Line style of the top border edge. CSS [code]border-top-style[/code]. Defaults to none.
Width in pixels of the bottom border edge. CSS [code]border-bottom-width[/code]. A border is only painted when its style is not none.
Width in pixels of the left border edge. CSS [code]border-left-width[/code]. A border is only painted when its style is not none.
Width in pixels of the right border edge. CSS [code]border-right-width[/code]. A border is only painted when its style is not none.
Width in pixels of the top border edge. CSS [code]border-top-width[/code]. A border is only painted when its style is not none.

Whether the declared size refers to the content box or the border box. Numeric values are: [code]0[/code] = [constant BOX_SIZING_CONTENT_BOX] / CSS [code]content-box[/code] (the CSS default), [code]1[/code] = [constant BOX_SIZING_BORDER_BOX] / CSS [code]border-box[/code]. CSS [code]box-sizing[/code].
Ordered list of drop and inner shadows, painted first-on-top like CSS. Each entry is a [WebBoxShadow]. CSS [code]box-shadow[/code].
Number of segments used to tessellate each rounded corner. Higher values produce smoother corners at a small performance cost.
Horizontal ([member Vector2.x]) and vertical ([member Vector2.y]) radius of the bottom-left corner, enabling elliptical corners. CSS [code]border-bottom-left-radius[/code].
Horizontal ([member Vector2.x]) and vertical ([member Vector2.y]) radius of the bottom-right corner, enabling elliptical corners. CSS [code]border-bottom-right-radius[/code].
Horizontal ([member Vector2.x]) and vertical ([member Vector2.y]) radius of the top-left corner, enabling elliptical corners. CSS [code]border-top-left-radius[/code].
Horizontal ([member Vector2.x]) and vertical ([member Vector2.y]) radius of the top-right corner, enabling elliptical corners. CSS [code]border-top-right-radius[/code].
Inner spacing in pixels between the bottom border and the content. CSS [code]padding-bottom[/code].
Inner spacing in pixels between the left border and the content. CSS [code]padding-left[/code].
Inner spacing in pixels between the right border and the content. CSS [code]padding-right[/code].
Inner spacing in pixels between the top border and the content. CSS [code]padding-top[/code].

constants.constant: The background is painted under the border, filling the entire border box. CSS [code]background-clip: border-box[/code].
The background is clipped to the padding box, stopping at the inner border edge. CSS [code]background-clip: padding-box[/code].
The background is clipped to the content box. CSS [code]background-clip: content-box[/code].
No border is drawn and its width is treated as zero. CSS [code]border-style: none[/code].
A single solid line. CSS [code]border-style: solid[/code].
Two parallel solid lines. CSS [code]border-style: double[/code].
The declared size sets the content box; border and padding are added outside it. The CSS default. CSS [code]box-sizing: content-box[/code].
The declared size sets the border box; border and padding are drawn inside it. CSS [code]box-sizing: border-box[/code].
